runtime.qualification: Declared locked pilot package/dependency scripts only; no install/check/audit/build/dry-run performed. Effect successor not implemented by these pilot files.

envelope.source_constraints: Version10 requires ios. General admission does not otherwise bind each accepted daily version to one source; typed reader separately enforces ios+reviewed8/10. Supplement path further limits ios8/android4,5.

retained_profiles.typed_query: Reviewed Apple ios daily8/10 summaries only; timestamp null for aggregate, dates/timezone retained, omitted missing never zero. WHOOP cycle steps do not substitute for daily Apple steps. Android/location/usage/raw-session typed parity unqualified.
retained_profiles.archive_read: Full_export scope exposes retained Apple/Android original envelopes/revisions/provider sidecars/embedded JSON binary and separate supplements; original bytes exact. This does not create typed equivalence, live phone access or data never uploaded. Android Raw API Snapshot NDJSON not accepted.
retained_profiles.native_baseline: Assigned baseline Appleexport8 remains active. Pilot v10/historical reading does not bump native version.
retained_profiles.saved_profile_identity: Envelope has source/schema/revision, no saved app profile name or reliable Summary/Detailed discriminator; no invented profile filters.

source_head_identity.account: users.id/session-derived user_id; no caller-supplied tenant for owner read
source_head_identity.original: exports.id/user_id, object_key, encryption_key_id, plaintext_sha256, byte_count, source, envelope/daily versions, exported_at/received_at
source_head_identity.current_head: daily_records PRIMARY KEY(user_id,owner_date), NOT source/device/selection; newest exported_at wins then newer received_at tie. Another device/narrower export may replace visible current fields.
source_head_identity.historical: Older envelopes remain exports rows/original bytes until policy cleanup; plaintext SHA256 dedup account-scoped. Separate supplemental_exports/records do not replace daily_records.
source_head_identity.cursor: Base64url canonical JSON [received_at,id], max160chars; tenant filtering occurs each query. Not authenticated grant/snapshot/source-bound cursor; export listing explicitly not snapshot during uploads/deletes.
source_head_identity.temporal_limits: Envelope canonicalTimestamp uses Date.parse/toISOString (millisecond instants) for head ordering; original bytes remain exact. New exact-numeric/time source semantics require versioned reconciliation rather than relying on parsed JSON/JS numbers.
